description: Generate a Hailuo 2.3 video from a required primary image; the aspect ratio is adaptive. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

isPro.description: Whether to use the model's professional generation mode when supported. Defaults to false.

promptOptimizer.description: Whether Nexscope should optimize the video prompt before generation. Defaults to false.

videoTime.description: Video duration in seconds. Supported values: 6, 10.
